# VIRTUAL HELP CENTER

# **VIRTUAL HELP CENTER FOR**

# **SELF-REPRESENTED****LITIGANTS**

## **IMPORTANT INFORMATION**

- Please note that this information applies only to the Court of Common Pleas General Division. For help regarding a municipal case, you can visit the [Help Center](https://cincyhelpcenter.org/) or the [Self- Help Center](https://www.hamiltoncountyohio.gov/government/courts/court_of_domestic_relations/self_help_resources) for a domestic relations matter.

- Court Staff cannot provide legal advice
- Court staff cannot discuss your case without the opposing side present as that would be an [ex parte communication](https://hamiltoncountycourts.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Glossary-of-Terms-10-28-24.pdf).
- Keep updated contact information with the Hamilton County Clerk of Courts so the Courtroom can contact you, if needed.  File a [notification form](https://www.courtclerk.org/forms/notificationform.pdf).
- You may represent yourself; however, you are expected to have knowledge of the law and legal procedure.  A self-represented litigant is subject to the same standards as those represented by an attorney. _Fontain v. Sandhu_, 2021-Ohio-2750, ¶ 13 (1st Dist.) _._

![](https://hamiltoncountycourts.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/Scales-1.jpg)
